title: Bananas Are Berries Heavy Cotton T-Shirt, Retro Fruit Graphic Tee, Funny Botany Gift
intro:
A confident banana in sunglasses and a shocked strawberry bring a surprising plant fact to life. Retro flowers, warm colors, and bold Bananas Are Berries. Strawberries Are Not. lettering make this a playful design for science fans, biology teachers, and fruit lovers.

THE FACT BEHIND THE DESIGN
In botany, bananas are classified as berries. Strawberries are aggregate accessory fruits, so they do not meet the botanical definition of a berry.
